job.title: Biomedical Service Engineer
job.description:
Biomedical Service Engineer


Join a global leader in medical infusion technology!


We are seeking an experienced Biomedical Service Engineer to join our growing Sydney team. This role combines field service work across major hospital sites with hands on workshop support from our Sydney base. You’ll work with advanced infusion technology used in critical care environments, ensuring devices perform safely, accurately, and reliably.

This is a fantastic opportunity for a senior biomed or electronics engineer who enjoys autonomy, problem?solving, and working closely with clinical stakeholders. Interstate travel will be required at times to support customers across Australia.

What You’ll Be Doing

  • Service, support, and troubleshoot advanced infusion devices
  • Manage on?site device performance across key Sydney hospital partners
  • Conduct preventative maintenance, calibration, and performance verification
  • Provide workshop based repairs, testing, and technical support
  • Respond to urgent service requests and fault reports
  • Maintain accurate service documentation and compliance records
  • Work closely with clinical staff, biomedical teams, and hospital engineering departments
  • Collaborate with national and global technical support teams
  • Travel interstate when required

What You’ll Bring

  • 4–6+ years’ experience in biomedical engineering, hospital biomed technician work, or electronics engineering
  • Proven experience servicing medical devices in hospital or clinical environments
  • Strong diagnostic, troubleshooting, and fault finding capability
  • Ability to work independently across field and workshop settings
  • Excellent communication skills and confidence engaging with clinical stakeholders
  • High attention to detail and strong commitment to safety and regulatory standards
  • Full Australian working rights

Nice to Have

  • Experience with infusion therapy equipment or other life supporting medical devices
  • Familiarity with medical device compliance, quality systems, and safety frameworks
  • Previous experience working closely with ICU, theatres, or high facuity clinical teams

Qualifications

  • Tertiary qualification in biomedical engineering, electronics, mechatronics, or related fields (preferred)
  • Significant experience servicing medical devices in hospital or clinical environments

What’s On Offer

  • $100,000 – $110,000 base salary + superannuation
  • Car allowance
  • Bonus potential
  • Stable, long term role with a global medical technology leader
  • Supportive, down toearth team culture
  • Opportunities to deepen technical expertise and grow your career

How to Apply


Submit your resume using the Apply Now button. Applications will be reviewed as they are received.

We appreciate all applications, but only shortlisted candidates will be contacted.
